name: softglaze-browser-connector
description: Connects Claude Code to the SoftGlaze AI tools inside SoftGlaze Browser 1.0.22 or newer on the same Windows computer, through a small dependency-free Node.js bridge that only talks to 127.0.0.1. Install it next to the SoftGlaze Browser skills plugin. Every change waits for your approval in the SoftGlaze app.

token.title: SoftGlaze AI token
token.description: A token from SoftGlaze Browser: SoftGlaze AI page, Tokens tab, Create token. It starts with sgai_. Make one for this app only. It is stored in your system's secure storage.

port.title: SoftGlaze AI port
port.description: The port shown on the SoftGlaze AI page (8080 unless the Owner changed it on the Settings tab).
